verdict.rationale: Steel provides cloud browser sessions that agents can spin up on demand and drive without a human. Integrations with OpenAI/Claude Computer Use, AgentKit, CrewAI and similar frameworks let those agent loops run autonomously against Steel, and auth context reuse avoids repeated logins. However, the orchestration, scheduling and triggering of automations must come from the user's own code or third-party frameworks; Steel itself only supplies the browser infrastructure. Missing for 10: native scheduling or recurring-run configuration, triggers/webhooks to launch automations in the background, a first-party way to set up a persistent automation without external orchestration code, and independent corroboration of unattended background runs.
